aboutMe.title: About me
aboutMe.imageAlt: Ángel Balboa - Director of Podología Balboa
aboutMe.paragraph1: My name is Ángel. Dedication to health has always been my vocation, and it was through podiatry that I found my path to help patients with specific, everyday problems.
aboutMe.paragraph2: What can I do for you? Provide the full range of podiatric treatments, drawing on a deep knowledge of human anatomy, physiology, pathophysiology, lower-limb biomechanics, radiology, pharmacology, general medicine and surgery.
